description: This file provides functions and types for analyzing, parsing, and reconstructing shell commands, with special handling for Windows shell commands and complex command chains. It includes utilities for splitting commands, escaping arguments, and resolving command resolutions, focusing on security and correctness in command execution contexts.

methods.name: isDoubleQuoteEscape
methods.description: Checks if the next character is an escape sequence within double quotes.

methods.name: isEscapedLineContinuation
methods.description: Checks if the next character indicates a line continuation.

methods.name: isShellCommentStart
methods.description: Determines if a position in the source string starts a shell comment.

methods.name: splitShellPipeline
methods.description: Splits a shell command into pipeline segments, handling heredocs and quoting.

methods.name: findWindowsUnsupportedToken
methods.description: Detects unsupported tokens in Windows shell commands.

methods.name: tokenizeWindowsSegment
methods.description: Tokenizes a Windows command segment into arguments, respecting quotes.

methods.name: stripWindowsShellWrapper
methods.description: Recursively removes known Windows shell wrappers from a command string.

methods.name: stripWindowsShellWrapperOnce
methods.description: Removes a single layer of Windows shell wrapper if present.

methods.name: analyzeWindowsShellCommand
methods.description: Analyzes a Windows shell command string for safety and parses it into segments.

methods.name: isWindowsPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the platform string indicates a Windows OS.

methods.name: parseSegmentsFromParts
methods.description: Parses raw command parts into structured command segments.

methods.name: splitCommandChainWithOperators
methods.description: Splits a command string into chain parts (&&, ||, ;) while respecting quotes.

methods.name: shellEscapeSingleArg
methods.description: Escapes a single argument for shell safety using single quotes.

methods.name: findWindowsUnsupportedToken
methods.description: Detects unsupported tokens in Windows commands.

methods.name: tokenizeWindowsSegment
methods.description: Tokenizes Windows command segments into arguments.

methods.name: windowsEscapeArg
methods.description: Escapes a Windows argument, quoting if necessary, avoiding unsafe tokens.

methods.name: rebuildWindowsShellCommandFromSource
methods.description: Rebuilds a Windows shell command from source, applying segment rendering.

methods.name: rebuildShellCommandFromSource
methods.description: Rebuilds a shell command from source, handling Windows and non-Windows platforms.

methods.name: renderWindowsQuotedArgv
methods.description: Renders Windows arguments with proper escaping for shell safety.

methods.name: renderQuotedArgv
methods.description: Renders arguments with proper escaping depending on platform.

methods.name: finalizeRebuiltShellCommand
methods.description: Finalizes the rebuilt shell command, checking segment count.

methods.name: resolvePlannedSegmentArgv
methods.description: Resolves the argv array for a command segment, considering resolution policies.

methods.name: renderSafeBinSegmentArgv
methods.description: Renders a command segment's argv as a safe, literal string.

methods.name: buildSafeShellCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command with arguments safely quoted to prevent globbing/expansion.

methods.name: buildSafeBinsShellCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command with specific segments forcibly quoted as literals.

methods.name: buildEnforcedShellCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command with all segments enforced as literals.

methods.name: splitCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a command string into parts based on chain operators.

methods.name: analyzeShellCommand
methods.description: Analyzes a shell command string for safety, parsing into segments and chains.

methods.name: analyzeArgvCommand
methods.description: Analyzes an argv array into a command analysis, resolving command resolution.
